R360.note: Narrows supports() to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken, matching what authenticate() actually casts to; no other change.

R361.note: RFC 4515-correct escaping of *()\ and NUL before concatenation; escaping '/' too is harmless (round-trips to itself).

R362.note: Extension allowlist is the required CWE-434 fix, but the added 10MB size cap is an unrequested restriction not implied by the finding and could silently reject legitimate large uploads that succeeded before.

R363.note: toRealPath()+Path.startsWith() correctly fixes the sibling-bypass; only side effect is missing files now returning 403 instead of 404, stated in the write-up and doesn't block legitimate existing-file access.

R364.note: realpath()-based containment check with separator-aware prefix comparison closes the wrapper/sibling bypass without restricting legitimate relative filenames.

R365.note: GetRelativePath containment check correctly blocks the absolute-path override while leaving legitimate relative filenames unaffected.

R366.note: Contract requires rich-text tags be preserved via allowlist sanitization; th:text instead escapes everything, dropping all rich-text rendering rather than sanitizing it as the contract calls for.

R367.note: SAFE_FILENAME regex restricts filenames to alnum/dot/dash/underscore, beyond what neutralizing CRLF requires, and could reject legitimate filenames with other characters (e.g. spaces); also asserts FTPClient itself escapes CRLF internally, which is not established, though the allowlist independently closes the vector.

R368.note: Allowlist maps exactly the two functions that existed to be dispatched; no legitimate functionality lost since no other command was ever valid.

R369.note: Drops cmd.exe /c shell entirely and passes host/count as separate ProcessBuilder arguments, closing shell metacharacter injection with no added restriction.

R370.note: Allowlist of absolute tool paths matches the endpoint's stated 'handful of diagnostic utilities' contract; target argument still passed through unmodified.

R371.note: Replaces shell grep with native file()+strpos(), eliminating the shell entirely while preserving the literal-match semantics and return shape.
